title: Chapter 221: Extermination Of The Clan
content:
Chapter 221: Extermination Of The Clan

The powerful Xiao clans walked slowly towards the foot of the mountain together, and each step shocked the Xiao clans.

Finally, can you go back?

The scene when I entered the ancestral land was as if it was yesterday.

The road down the mountain is also very long, but everyone is not arrogant or impatient, and their pace is very steady.

Through the misty fog, the scene in the Xiao clan suddenly appeared in front of everyone.

At this moment, dry tears flowed again.

"Xiao clan, we are back!"

......

"Xiao clan, your path is over!"

A domineering voice came from outside the Xiao clan and echoed in the Xiao clan's void.

The next moment, countless powerful auras surged in from all directions outside the Xiao clan.

Feeling this, outside the Xiao clan ancestral land, Xiao Jing and other Xiao clan members looked ugly, but their eyes were extremely firm.

At this moment, the entire Xiao clan members had gathered here, and obviously they had already made preparations for the final battle.

With a loud bang.

The guardian formation that protected the Xiao clan for endless years was broken.

Countless huge fragments poured down from the void, shaking the heavens.

"All Xiao people obey orders and prepare to fight!"

"I, Xiao people, would rather die while standing than live on their knees!"

As the leader of the Xiao clan, Xiao Jing stood up and roared.

The other Xiao people also looked resolute.

Faced with the situation of life and death, none of the Xiao tribe present chose to compromise.

This is the arrogance of a great clan who has passed on for endless years.

At this time, densely packed strong men were already rushing towards this place.

The three leaders were the patriarchs of Ye Chu and Xie tribes.

"Xiao Jing, I haven't seen each other for many years, so I'm fine."

After glanced at the Xiao clan, the Ye clan leader looked at Xiao Jing and then spoke.

At this moment, there are as many as thousands of people in the Xiao clan in the field, most of which are at the realm of the Immortal Lord and Immortal Lord. It is not enough to face the strong people of the three clans.

But this is already the only power of the Xiao clan.

At the deepest part of the Xiao clan, Xiao Luo's eyes were red, and he hugged a small tower in his arms tightly.

This is the treasure of the Xiao clan, an extremely rare space treasure.

It contains the universe, and even living creatures can be stuffed into it.

Now, this small tower contains almost the entire Xiao clan members, who are all women, young and old, and have low cultivation.

Similarly, it is also the future of the Xiao clan.

"Xiao Luo, the future of the Xiao clan is in your hands. In this, there are not only tribe members, but also the inheritance accumulated over the years of my Xiao clan. You have great luck, and I believe you will be able to survive. .”

Xiao Jing patted Xiao Luo on the shoulder and said word by word.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo looked ugly, "Great Elder, I want to fight side by side with the tribe!"

"Nothing!"

Xiao Jing directly rejected Xiao Luo's request.

"I am the Great Elder, you must listen to me!"

"When the fight starts, you can escape according to the situation. If you can't escape, then enter the ancestral land. Perhaps there will be a glimmer of life in the ancestral land."

After explaining this, Xiao Jing turned around and left, leaving Xiao Luo with unwilling expressions and clenched his fists.

"I, Xiao Luo, one day if I rise up, I will destroy your tribes and vent your anger!"

And now, looking at the powerful three tribes who were almost surrounded by water in the void, Xiao Luo felt a little desperate.

It seems that for the sake of the present, we can only enter the ancestral land and gain a glimmer of hope.

At this moment, all the Xiao people were full of blood and looked up at these enemies.

Seeing this scene, the strong men of the three tribes kept sneering.

"Is this all the strength of your Xiao clan now?"

The head of the Chu clan came forward and mocked him.

"I didn't expect that after so many years, your Xiao clan has fallen to this point. You are called the ancient family together with us. You Xiao clan is no longer worthy!"

On the other side, the Ye clan leader also shook his head slightly.

I thought the Xiao clan would have some powerful trump card, but I didn't expect that I was thinking too much.

If I had known this, I wouldn't have had to wait for so long.

Immediately, the Ye clan leader was preparing to issue an order to exterminate the clan.

And at this moment, the Ye clan leader suddenly looked behind the Xiao clan.

That is the exit of the Xiao clan’s ancestral land.

At the same time, everyone present looked over intently.

"What's that?"

At this time, the Xiao clan looked a little excited.

Could it be said?

I saw two blurry figures slowly emerged from the exit of the Xiao clan’s ancestral land.

Soon, the figure was solemn.

The Xiao clan members immediately saw the identities of the two.

"Lord of Huang City? Miss Lu? You guys,,,"

Xiao Jing stared at Lu Daosheng's father and daughter in a daze.

At this moment, there was a plop.

Xiao Chen actually knelt down directly towards Lu Daosheng.

"Lord of Huang City, please save my Xiao clan. My Xiao clan is willing,

Before he finished speaking, Lu Daosheng raised his hand to interrupt Xiao Chen's next words.

Seeing this, Xiao Chen looked desperate.

It seems that the Xiao clan has really lost his fate.

However, Lu Daosheng said indifferently: "You Xiao clan don't need me to save you."

As soon as these words came out, everyone in the Xiao clan was confused.

In the void, the Ye clan leader looked at Lu Daosheng and the others with confusion and said, "Who are you two and why did you get out of there?"

As far as he knows, that is a place where only the Xiao tribe can enter.

But Lu Daosheng and the others did not seem to be from the Xiao clan.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Don't be nervous, I'm here to visit, you guys continue."

Hearing this, the Ye clan leader breathed a sigh of relief.

His intuition told him that the person in front of him was not simple.

Fortunately, the other party was not from the Xiao clan and did not choose to help the Xiao clan.

Then, the Xiao clan can be destroyed.

"Everyone obeys the order, and all the people of the Xiao clan will be killed without mercy!"

The leader of the Ye clan held an immortal-level sword in his hand and shouted softly at the Xiao clan.

Suddenly, the strong men of the three tribes present roared one after another, and then rushed towards the Xiao tribe.

Among these strong people, there are many strong people in the Immortal Emperor Realm. The momentum is united, which can be called a destruction of the world.

Faced with this, Xiao Jing's eyes were about to break.

"Welcome to the enemy!"

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already pulled Lu Xue to a safe place to watch the next good show.

On the last part of the Xiao clan, Xiao Luo, who is a genius of the Xiao clan, struggled for a long time, and finally chose to protect the Xiao clan's last bloodline.

Immediately, Xiao Luo turned around and rushed towards the ancestral land behind him.

When he saw Xiao Luo, he wanted to rush into the ancestral land.

The patriarch of the Xie clan was shocked and quickly ordered the strong men of the Xie clan to intercept Xiao Luo.

When his daughter fell in love with Xiao Luo at first sight, she secretly investigated Xiao Luo in private.

After this investigation, he found that Xiao Luo was really the pride of heaven. Even in the declining Xiao clan, Xiao Luo still showed his strong talent. It took only 100,000 years to reach it. In the Immortal Lord Realm, he was admitted to Tiandi Academy for exception.

Such a genius, even as the leader of the Xie clan, he was shocked by it.

So when his daughter came into contact with Xiao Luo, she turned a blind eye and did not choose to stop her.
